title: Report paired effects, calibration, uncertainty, and complete totals
description:
## Scope

Compute per-cell and pooled accuracy, macro-F1, recall, log loss, multiclass Brier, top-label ECE/reliability data, latency, requests/attempts, and returned token usage. Mark unavailable probability metrics rather than fabricate distributions. Use paired target bootstrap and draw/order resampling appropriate to each declared contrast; do not treat repeated target rows as independent observations.

## Definition of done

Synthetic fixtures check exact metrics and aggregation weights, missing/malformed-row denominators, deterministic paired intervals, repeated-draw pooling, and counts against the preflight. Report percentage-point changes separately from relative percentages and do not invent dollar pricing.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Report paired effects, calibration, uncertainty, and complete totals
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given synthetic paired decisions with missing distributions and repeated draws
    When an offline report is generated twice with the same seed
    Then effects and intervals agree, unavailable metrics are identified, and totals reconcile with the matrix
```

comments.text: Inference audit found that the forced Holm protocol field had no corresponding justified p-value procedure. User delegated the choice; preserve the original descriptive paired 95% target/draw bootstrap intervals and make no adjusted significance claim. New protocols will explicitly declare no family correction; previously frozen Holm-labelled protocols remain readable and must report correction unavailable. No p-values will be inferred from confidence interval endpoints. Implementation and refreshed exact preflight hashes are being verified offline; no live results.
